narr: Thunderstorms developed along a stationary front over the area on August 23rd. These thunderstorms were slow moving and produced heavy rainfall over Long Island. The thunderstorms developed in an environment with 1.5 to 1.7 precipitable water and CAPE values of 1500 - 2000 J/kg. The thunderstorms produced locally up to 2 to 3 inches of rain in a 2 hour period.
